summary: Added a Windows equivalent of the Mac dev-checkout launcher: Play Latest.bat (locates Git Bash, runs the existing Play Latest.command, pauses on failure) and a Windows branch in tools/create-dev-launcher.py that emits a named artifacts/L5R Emperor - Latest.lnk shortcut via WScript.Shell, alongside the existing Mac .app path.
validation: Ran python3 tools/create-dev-launcher.py on this Windows machine; verified the resulting .lnk's TargetPath/WorkingDirectory/Description via PowerShell. Launched Play Latest.bat via os.startfile (the same ShellExecute path Explorer uses for a double-click) against this checkout with a temporary junction to an already-installed .tools toolchain; confirmed it found Git Bash, ran tools/run.sh, streamed output into artifacts/checks/latest-launch.log, and progressed into the real dotnet build of src/L5R.Client. Stopped the run there (no native Windows graphical playtest of the launched game itself) and removed the temporary junction/test artifacts before committing. python3 -m ast-checked create-dev-launcher.py for syntax.
remaining: None for this task; ready for review. Native Windows graphical playtest of the game window itself (not just the launcher reaching the build step) was not performed.
